all_checks_passed: All checks passed. The migration can start.
database_migration_done: The copy finished and every row count matches. Restart with the new database URL.
database_migration_running: The migration is running. Do not close this page.
fix_the_failed_checks_and_run_them_again: Fix the failed checks and run them again.
koreograf_does_not_change_its_own_config: Koreograf does not rewrite its own configuration files.
migration_password_not_stored: The password is sent once for these checks and the migration. It is never written to SQLite, the audit log, or an API response.
migration_starts_maintenance: Koreograf enters maintenance mode: no new jobs start, running jobs must finish first, and every user sees a banner. A failure keeps SQLite and leaves maintenance mode.
restart_koreograf_after_the_change: Restart Koreograf with the new value. Keep the password in KOREOGRAF_DATABASE_PASSWORD_FILE.
rollback_switches_the_url_back: To roll back, stop Koreograf, set KOREOGRAF_DATABASE_URL back to empty, and start again from the unchanged SQLite file.
